messages:
sam: Weekly release-train bulletin: brief security maintenance Sat 00:30-04:30 UTC. Expect a brief canary tilt to ap-southeast around 02:15 UTC for ~60m. Post exceptions by EOD.

eva: Which services are in-scope?

sam: in-scope: inference-core, model-cache, routing-proxy. Out-of-scope: dashboard, metrics-ingest.

raj: We have a scheduled embeddings rollout finishing Sat morning. Owner: raj. Can we get an exception?

sam: Submit exception with risk notes. If it's not touching kernel libs we can allow.

raj: exception: embeddings-finalize (owner: raj) - smoke passed, no quant-kernel touches. Requesting approval to continue.

deploy-bot: Exception received: embeddings-finalize. Permitted under exception ID RTX-320. Auto-rollouts allowed. :white_check_mark:

morgan: ops - what's the tilt command so I can update runbook?

ops-bot: Tilt command: `routingctl shift --from global-canary --to ap-se-tilt --percent 65 --duration 60m`

sam: We'll provision 2 temporary gpu-helper nodes in ap-southeast. Command: `infractl node provision --zone ap-southeast-1 --type gpu-small --count 2 --ttl 2h`

eva: Adding console banner and a short notice in release dashboard now.

raj: I'll queue a smoke-run after nodes ready and post results.

sam: Fallback policy:
```
trigger: error-rate > 1% sustained 2m OR p95 > 2.5s
action: reroute -> model:stable, pause-rollouts, notify -> #incidents
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled actions: add-banner (2147601800), provision-nodes (2147602200), routing-tilt (2147602500)

sam: Thanks all. Post exceptions here. We'll monitor and post updates during the window.
